reviews.title: Super comfy
reviews.body: It’s really comfy and true to size as expected.

reviews.title: Sexy Boots
reviews.body: I am a boots connoisseur and these look great on a tall person. My go to boots for venturing out since I got them.

reviews.title: Great boots
reviews.body: Fit a bit snugly at first, but broke in well. Fit is dead on after this break in period. Soles are soft, and feel pretty nice. Boots don’t feel too heavy after a full day of use. Seem to be waterproof as advertised, although I haven’t submerged them in puddles yet. Purchased to muck stalls, and seem to be holding up for that use. I wear them in public, alternating with my Solovairs.

reviews.title: Traction is great!
reviews.body:
I have a steep and occasionally icy driveway. My highest priority when I bought these boots was TRACTION, and these have great traction!

Same soft rubber bumps on the sole as Sorel’s big boot, but now in a smaller, more nimble boot.

Love everything about this boot. So well made.

reviews.title: Fits perfectly. comfortable Very nice leather
reviews.body:
Dislike : I expected the leather shines little. But it wasn't.
Like : when I wears it feels perfectly fit.

reviews.title: Great style, but not true to size.
reviews.body: I like the style and I was surprised it’s more cushiony now. But the problem is too big for my usual size. Tried to get another size but the prize is different 😬

reviews.title: Fits well, feet stay dry and warm
reviews.body: Well built boot that fits well. The boot has a bit of a heel cup to keep your foot in place and leave good room in the toe box. I wear a size 9D. I am wearing these now in Chicago that received 10” of snow yesterday. Through snow, sludge, and water my feet have stayed dry. Couple them with a good pair of wool socks and my feet do not get cold in single digit weather.

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.body:
Good fit
You get what you pay for.
Excellent quality

reviews.title: Comfort
reviews.body: I have 5 pairs of Sorel - I love the fit the quality and the comfort!!

reviews.title: More comfortable than expected!
reviews.body: I know Sorels are supposed to last a long time, but I thought I would have to sacrifice a little comfort. I can wear these all day long and they feel great
